title: Universal Aimbot by W31rd Hub
features:
---> Credits Tab <---
> Script information.
> Copy discord link.

---> Aimbot Tab <---
> Target part Head/Torso [Choose body part to aim at].
> Turn Aimbot [Auto-targeting on players].
> Wall-check [Target only players not behind walls].

---> Hitbox expander Tab <---
> Turn hitbox expander [extends torso hitbox on players].
> Target user [enter username to targer specifically].
> Head size [Set size of torso hitbox].
> Hitbox transparency [Set transparency of torso].
> Hitbox color [choose color for torso].
> Rainbow hitbox.

---> Fov circle Tab <---
> Turn FOV circle  [Show visual circle on screen].
> Fov circle size [Set FOV circle radius].
> FOV circle color [Choose color for FOV circle].

---> Players ESP Tab <---
> ESP All Players [Green/red boxes on players].

---> Settings <---
> Background image transparency.
> Background image ID [Change GUI background image].
